Chapter one 第一章

Origin Story

I've loved technology since I was a little girl, and I'm passionate about games, design and cybersecurity. My achievements started in high school, but long before that I was teaching myself and building my skills. One question has always driven me: how does this work? That curiosity took me from a first award-winning app to hacking systems, building virtual worlds and programming drones.

2019

The first win

In high school, I built an educational app called "My Little Laboratory" and took 1st place nationwide in the Ministry of Education programming challenge.

Three kinds of reality

VR

A whole world you enter with a headset. I built a multiplayer firefighting simulator and an adventure in Makr Al-Shayaheen cave.
